# Samrakshana Yoga Kendra

> Yoga therapy and yoga classes in Raja Annamalaipuram (R.A. Puram), Chennai, India, led by founder R. Ramya (Ramya Murali Krishnan), a QCI Level 6 Yoga Therapist trained at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram. Founded October 2015. Women-owned.

## Key facts
- Address: No 13/11, First Cross Street, Raja Annamalaipuram, Chennai 600 028, Tamil Nadu, India (near Mylapore, Mandaveli, Alwarpet)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 86101 25195
- Hours: classes from 5:30 am to 7 pm
- Google rating: 4.9 from 111 reviews (October 2026)
- Sessions: private one-to-one yoga therapy, group sessions, pranayama, meditation, healing chants; in person and online
- Specialities: yoga for back, neck and shoulder pain; yoga for seniors; yoga for children and adults with special needs (autism spectrum); prenatal yoga; weight and lifestyle with diet counselling and naturopathy; teacher training; corporate wellness
- Founder credentials: MSc Yoga (TNPESU), PhD scholar in Yoga, QCI Level 6 Yoga Therapist, Yoga Certification Board (Ministry of AYUSH) yoga therapist, Examiner TQ Cert (AYUSH), RYT 500, 400-hr TTC Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram, 100-hr Vinyasa Krama (Srivatsa Ramaswami), Diploma in Special Education (ASD), M.Music
- Media: "Udal Suvasam Yogam with R. Ramya", 3-part Tamil series, Hindu Tamil Thisai (YouTube, 2019); Mylapore Times feature, 21 May 2020
